notes: Triple hook: context (story of a city on the moon) + lean (forbidden to look at Earth) + snapback (everyone obeys, except one boy). cap: ' | ' = new block, ' / ' = new line, *word* = accent (blue italic serif), **word** = bold. y = top of the text block on screen. cont = continue the previous block on a new line.

sentences.text: This is the story of a city on the moon,
sentences.cap: This is the story / of a city / on the *moon,*

sentences.text: where no one is allowed to look at Earth.
sentences.cap: where **no one** / is allowed to look / at *Earth.*

sentences.text: The city was called Lunar Land.
From every street, you could see the Earth, big and blue in the black sky.
sentences.cap: From every street, / you could see / the *Earth,* | big and **blue** / in the black sky.

sentences.text: Every morning, the screens said the same words.
sentences.cap: Every morning, / the **screens** said / the same words.
sentences.say: Every morning, the screens, said the same words.

sentences.text: He believed it, like everyone else.
But one question never left him.
sentences.cap: But one question / never left him.

cta_rule: Regular reels end with 'Follow for part N.' only. Every 5th reel (reel_number 5, 10, 15 ...) adds 'Chapter one is free to read. The link is in my bio.' (or the current chapter) and the 'a story by Wahib' byline, to test whether it brings readers and whether it makes people swipe away.
renderer: render2.py (single background + Allen cut-out; not in this repo)
